title: Lesson 5
paragraph: ソフトウェア開発の道具

words.meaning: a set of steps for solving a problem or performing a task
words.example: The algorithm sorts the names into alphabetical order.

sentencePractice.prompt: The program follows a defined series of steps to sort names. Those steps form an ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: A problem-solving procedure is an algorithm; a failure and a software release are different concepts. All choices fit after an.

words.meaning: the instructions for a program written in a programming language
words.example: The developer checked the source code to understand the calculation.

words.meaning: a fault in software that can make it behave incorrectly
words.example: We found a bug that caused the page to freeze.

words.meaning: a targeted change to software that fixes a problem
words.example: The patch fixes the printing problem.

words.meaning: a newer release or change that improves or replaces existing software
words.example: The update adds support for a new file format.

words.meaning: a collection of reusable code that programs can call
words.example: The program uses a library to draw charts.

words.meaning: another program or package that software needs in order to work
words.japaneseMeaning: 依存ソフトウェア・依存関係
words.example: Install this dependency before running the application.

words.meaning: a managed place for storing project files and their change history
words.example: The team keeps its source code in a shared repository.

sentencePractice.prompt: The team stores project files together with their change history in a shared ____.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Storage of project files and version history identifies a repository; reusable code and application structure do not name that store.

words.meaning: written information explaining how software works or how to use it
words.japaneseMeaning: ドキュメント・技術文書
words.example: The documentation includes a complete installation example.

words.meaning: a reusable structure and set of tools for building applications
words.example: This framework provides a common structure for web applications.
